visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Scene opens in an indoor cafe. Two women sit at a dark table. The woman on the left, with brown hair and a checkered top, gestures toward a green dessert on a metal tray. The lighting is bright and even. (2) Close-up shot of the dessert: a mountain of green shaved ice topped with a thick bunch of fresh green coriander, sliced limes, and green grapes. (3) The camera pans as the woman on the left takes a spoonful of the ice. She wears a silver necklace and has visible makeup. Her expression is curious as she tastes the food. (4) Cut to a shot of the side dishes: small bowls containing translucent jellies and brown liquids. The woman on the left uses a spoon to mix some toppings into the ice. (5) The woman on the right, in a blue shirt, smiles and speaks toward the camera. In the background, modern cafe furniture and Christmas decorations are visible. (6) Close-up of a long, brown translucent jelly strip being lifted with a fork. The texture appears chewy and gelatinous. (7) Both women are seen eating the fresh coriander leaves directly from the top of the ice. They laugh and look at each other. (8) Final shot of the two women smiling and waving at the camera, with a thumb up from the woman on the left. The cafe background remains consistent.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, high-tempo electronic pop BGM. A cheerful female voice introduces the food with a high pitch and rapid pace. (2) A light 'pop' SFX sounds as the camera focuses on the dessert. The vocal clarity is high, recorded via a lavalier mic. (3) The speaker's tone remains excited as she describes the taste. The BGM maintains a steady, upbeat rhythm with synthesizers and a clear electronic beat. (4) A second female voice enters, imitating the first with a playful, teasing tone, causing both to laugh. (5) Audible metal clinking sounds occur as spoons touch the metal tray. (6) The BGM continues throughout, providing a consistent energy level beneath the high-arousal female dialogue. (7) The video ends with a synchronized farewell phrase from both voices, followed by a quick fade-out of the music.
